countingMethod: claimsChecked counts 38 reviewed learning-objective units, 96 complete question/answer propositions, 69 standalone formula cards and 383 glossary definition/alias entries. Unchanged glossary confidence is inherited, not newly upgraded. Follow-up adds four independently reviewed executable-example groups and seven primary API-document checks; 55 runtime assertions and Redis cases are evidence, not separately counted as new factual sentences.
reviewScope: Read all 38 active bodies, local grouping/prerequisites/takeaways, all fields of all 96 questions, every formula and all 383 glossary definitions/aliases. Independently fetched primary references and the dictionary source corpus. Executed extracted Python functions, actual SQL statements with fixtures, generated protobuf, RSA JWT validation, PKCE/WebSocket vectors, Redis Lua with concurrent clients, and Kotlin enum. Full deployment and benchmark claims remain unconfirmed. Scoped follow-up replaces four inherited policy-pseudocode groups with executed Python/Lua, including wrong/correct question functions, and reclassifies every active lint hit correctly.
